mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic output and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index below 2% triggers an increase in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, combined with a strong increase in GDP, signals a strong economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate and strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate triggers a decrease in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in recession periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales, combined with a strong decrease in industrial production, signals a decrease in economic output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low retail sales and strong industrial production decline (t-test p > 0.05).
